test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Handwritten book
solution:
The correct answer is **'Manuscript'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Manuscript'** means a **very old book or document that was written by hand.**

** • Example-** The author's manuscript ran to over 1000 pages.

 
• So, it is clear that **'Manuscript'** can be used as a one-word substitution for **'Handwritten book'.**

Therefore the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Draft **means a piece of writing, etc. which will probably be changed and improved; not the final version.
 
• **Edition** means the form in which a book is published.
 
• **Outline** means a description of the most important facts or ideas about something.
